### Before you open a PR

- [ ] `pnpm type-check` / `python -m pyright` — no new type errors
- [ ] `ruff check` / `ruff format` — lint clean
- [ ] `python -m pytest` — tests pass
- [ ] `pnpm build` or `python -m build` — package builds
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] Screenshots included for UI changes

### What changed

Briefly describe the change and why.

### Testing

How did you verify this works? Include commands run and results.

### Checklist

- [ ] This is a bug fix / feature / chore / docs
- [ ] I've read the contributing guidelines
- [ ] I've updated docs where relevant
